subject: math
description: Use secant-secant and tangent-secant power relationships to solve circle length problems.
learningObjectives: Identify secants, tangents, external segments, and whole secant lengths
Apply the secant-secant power relationship to solve for missing lengths
Apply the tangent-secant power relationship to solve for missing lengths
Choose the correct product relationship from a circle diagram
Check whether a length answer is reasonable in context
prerequisites: Solving simple quadratic equations by square roots
